New features and improvements.text: Various UI improvements.
Add an implicit stress update algorithm for the Munson-Dawson model.
Improve Maxwell damping performance for the undrained case with fluid configured and multi-step active.
Various minor improvements to concrete, cysoil, hardening, hoekbrownpac, and ubiquit constitutive models.
Add new intrinsic sketch.segment.node.create, update existing sketch.segment.node.delete and clean up related docs.
Fix bug with the thermal contribution to pore-pressure changes was using an extra biot-coefficient term.
Clarify documentation for the undrained thermal coefficient.
Add massflow seed command for reproducible results independent of thread count, restarts, and save/restore.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix bug with interactive cutting planes not rendering correctly.
Fix UI freeze when bringing application into the foreground after an extended period of time.
Fix bug causing slower cycling under the IMASS model.
Fix backward compatibility for grids created before introducing gridpoint group import/export.
Fix for possible non-orthogonal face apply.
Fix eigenvector calculation for the special case of high principle and low deviatoric stress.
Fix bug with contact.energy not throwing error if energy partition name does not exist.
Fix bug causing crash during save/restore of thermal analysis.

New features and improvements.text: Official release of MPoint.
Add command in Sketch (sketch shape) to generate various shapes (currently tunnels, slopes, open pit, dam shapes). Update UI wizards to allow previewing and validation.
Add a field to the Sketch Object Properties panel to display object ID.
Add optional residual joint properties to the IMASS model.
Refactor Hydration-Drucker-Prager model.
Add functionality for cleaning up objects in Sketch.
Add copy button for GeoBot code snippets.
Improve Python error handling.
Various security improvements.
Add functionality and plot item for Modal analysis.
Add to-elevation keyword to the zone generate from-topography command.
Add a plotitem menu option (on right click) to export a 3D model slice into a 2D geometry/grid/sketch.
Deprecate the isotropic, anisotropic, and null keywords for fluid and thermal constitutive models. Use linear and inactive instead.
Add extra variable interpolation for vectors and tensor quantities in automatic remeshing.
Allow re-discretization of faces with apply conditions if they become very stretched during remeshing.
Add 2D capability to SNBV package.
Marker reports are optimized and can be generated with text and vtk extensions.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix occasional UI lockup causing cycling to stop until a mouse click or key press.
Optimize Munson-Dawson creep-rate and Hosford-stress calculations to reduce numerical overflow, and add parameter validation and a stress cutoff.
Fix the vary keyword value modifier.
Fix structure node acceleration history always being zero for node-to-zone rigid links during dynamic calculation.

Fix several fluid flow bugs: reduce the tolerance for a gridpoint to be considered fully saturated, limit the volumetric strain pressure correction by the cutoff pore pressure, and fix the first solve command possibly using an incorrect wet density.

Fix several thermal bugs: the implicit matrix not updating when thermal properties or mechanical mass were modified, the thermal servo table not being implemented, and thermal and fluid servo timesteps not being preserved after restore.
Fix hysteretic damping not turning off when zone.hysteretic is set in FISH to a value other than 1, 3, 4, 5, or 6. Previously, the shear modulus was reduced to the minimum factor.
Fix holes occasionally appearing in the ZoneJoint plot when the "Interpolate" option is selected.
Fix bug in cutting rblocks with geometries with very small edges.
Fix bug in CY Joint model that caused excessive shear stresses to occur when loading direction was reversed.
Fix bug in matrix flow.

Documentation and examples.text: Fix bug in calculation of friction angle for zone joints during a FOS analysis.
Add example simulating stability of landfill over varved clay.
Add example of structural support of a layered embankment with ponded water.
Update "Installation of a Triple-Anchored Excavation Wall" example to use liner SELs and add extra comparisons.

New features and improvements.text: Minor improvements to multi threading.

Bug Fixes.text: Saturation changes from mechanical volume changes now correctly account for porosity in partially saturated gridpoints.

New features and improvements.text: Add multi-select capability when adding files from the project tree right-click menu.
Add reset-on-solve keyword to the implicit servo settings in both fluid and thermal.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix possible crash when using the zone.prop FISH intrinsic during a splitting operation or an operator.
Fix bug with the progress bar displaying incorrectly.
Fix various minor MPI bugs.
Fix crash when deleting zones with attaches.
Fix bug with gridpoint positions wrongly moving to (0,0,0) in some cases with attaches.
Fix SUBI model accidentally broken from 47.
Fix gp.flux, which did not survive save/restore or even cycles when thermal was inactive.
Fix command processing error in zone fluid implicit servo gain implicit.
Fix non-plotting of mpoints until cmodel is assigned.

New features and improvements.text: Adjust code titles in plots and the GUI for MPoint, MineDW, XSite and MassFlow.

Saving files (images, movies, data, logs, and auto-saves) now automatically creates the target folder when needed and reports a clear error if the folder cannot be created, instead of failing silently or leaving stray folders.
Add option Viewer for IMAT.
Add extra variable interpolation for automatic remeshing.
XSite Enable the Parametric Study dialog for HPC users.
Significant Bug Fix:

If zones were nulled that were the target of attach conditions, it was possible that the flag that causes a grid-point to skip equations of motion would fail to be removed. Also some attach conditions in certain configurations along edges and faces would be retained if the grid-points connected to the nulled zones were not also marked null because they were still connected to an existing zone.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix crash in the Geometry plot item when cutting lines.
Fix crash when deleting zones with both fluid and thermal processes configured.
Fix a typo in the Hoek-Brown rapidTool (tensile to tension) and corrected incorrect commands displayed in different plotters.
Fix backward compatibility of restore for NorSand save files that was broken starting with Revision 47.
Fix the initialize-stress command was not including the effective cutoff value for the zone when computing effective horizontal stresses.
Fix if modulus-automatic was used after modulus-scale, then the check against the new value would happen against the scaled value rather than the value entered by the user (or no value).
Gravitational mass calculation when using both axisymmetry and fluid-flow was not using wet density.
Fix possible crash when separating zones connected to interface elements.
Fix bug that flowknot pore pressures were not updated when vertex pore pressures were modified using FISH.
Fix DFN cutting.
XSite Fix injection not working when the user specifies a minimum stress.
XSite Fix shear stress plot item.
XSite Fix an issue preventing FracMan files from being imported through the UI.
XSite Fix tables not updating properly.
XSite Fix the Parametric Study dialog not opening after startup.
XSite Fix microseismic event sizing.
XSite Fix accumulator option class.
XSite Fix MPI receive/send communication.

New features and improvements.text: MASSFLOW Improvements to drawpoint and marker counter plot items.
MASSFLOW Mine block information panes can now pop up to list all user-defined CSV columns.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix intermittent UI lockup during cycling.
Fix alignment issue with color bar text in plots.
Fix behavior when copying code from GeoBot side panel.
Fix issue with cutting plane type selection not allowing wedge or octant types.
Fix compatibility issue with shared and network folders.
Fix issue when restoring many save files in Python.
Particle coloring by ID reintroduced in the "Text Val" menu.
Fix small bugs affecting creation and display of links for liner elements.
Fix bug when building models with flow planes from deformable Griddle meshes.

New features and improvements.text: GeoBot (AI assistant) now available in the side panel.
Itasca Software now (optionally) logs command and FISH usage.
variables and functions visible in the Project Tree.
STL export from plots (through the right-click menu).
Update to Mohr-Coulomb and Ubiquitous-Joint type constitutive models to provide more accurate corrections at the boundary between tensile and shear failure.
Add property tables in documentation for all constitutive models.
User Defined Model (UDM) example now update for VS 2026.
Strain-Softening constitutive model now includes length-calibration property.
In license location dialog, remove expired licenses from the list of available licenses.
Extra variable, hysteretic and Maxwell damping interpolation for remeshing.
Split the extrusion line in Sketch by drawing a point.
Now possible to null zones during cycling when configure cluster is active.
Plot items now in the style of FLAC3D.
Many bug fixes, new examples and expanded documentation.
Update EULA for tools install.
Revamp of technical support dialog.
Now build with Visual Studio 2026.
Update libcurl to v8.19, libssl and libcrypto to v3.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix large-strain mode in v9.1+ was slower than v9.0.
Fix crash due to invalid imported geometry polygons.
Fix bug that constitutive model gui filter/range was broken.
Fix file compression behavior and UI in object tree.
Fix the default auto save directory was not a useful location.
Fix crash when tables exceed maximum limit of 500.
Fix ICGTools in support of SL licenses.
Fix ICGTools that installer was giving an error message and then not installing the HL/SL drivers.
Fix bug in reading encrypted files.
Fix filename processing error using RBLOCK import in Linux.
Fix undo logic bug in RBSN fictitious force between bodies and walls.
Fix assign area for RBSN stiffness data. TBD:figure out ineffective kinematics.
Fix RBSN logic in the springnetwork model.

New features and improvements.text: Legend format now can be intelligently be decimal or scientific.
Refactor and add property check for material stability for orthotropic and anisotropic elastic models.
Add ability to encrypt python data files.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix legend does not save active status on project save for some cases.
Fix geometry edge contour plot item.
Fix DXF export from plots should no longer have to be triangular.
Fix crash when exporting many dxf files.
Fix references to HoekBrown RapidTool docs for tables in the inputs.
Fix an exception with creating a PlotPage.
Fix remeshing on correcting stress interpolation
Fix remeshing)by introducing a new option to update reference geometry/data (re-initialize) according to user specified interval.
Fix in remeshing restore.
Fix subcontacts were not being assigned DFN fracture IDs for rigid blocks.
Fix DFN orientations were not being calculated correctly.
Fix bug in displaying of joint properties in the tree.

New features and improvements.text: Remeshing capabilities in FLAC2D.
Updated branded appearance of plot legends and fonts.
Addition of Munson-Dawson creep constitutive model.
Concrete constitutive model for structures.
for user-defined data (scalars, vectors and tensors).
Factor of safety analysis can now include a range.
Factor of safety analysis now work if elastic or null zones are present.
Curve fit capabilities added for Hoek-Brown rapid tool.
Now include specific points during meshing in SKETCH.
Improved copy-past functionality ion Sketch.
New command to create a circular shell or liner (structure shell create by-circle).
New examples.
Dip and dip direction can now be specified for joint-sets in Sketch.
Matrix flow for models imported from Griddle.

Bug Fixes.text: and 3DEC Ensure that all temporary geometry sets are deleted in block/zone generate command.
Fixes to structures for rigid blocks.
Parts of the documentation set were missing in the Revision 42 release.

New features and improvements.text: Added 'joint-parallel-strength' to the list of properties available for factor-of-safety strength reduction calculations.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix rendering of lines resulting from polygon plots with a cut-plane, accidentally introduced in revision 41.

New features and improvements.text: A number of changes intended to speed up slow rendering issues.
Add "Show only Group" back to zone plotitem.
Add strain outputs from interrogation points for structures.
Improve COMBA model when identifying the most critical joint using the norm.
Add optional property joint-parallel-strength for softening-ubiquitous and power-ubiquitous models; in_uj_jpstren for IMASS model.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix creating structural elements with import from-geometry and quadrilateral polygons.
Fix crash when manipulating sketch sets with content selector.
Fix UI: building blocks crash during in UI when switching between multiple sets of the same type through the content selector via the model pane.
Fix UI: with an exception/crash that happened in a hidden way when bad model information data was obtained.
Fix UI: file decompression from the project pane context menu was throwing an error.
Fix for zone.null intrinsic on assignment.
Fix slow Linux face group search.
Fix deleting balls and links.
Fix partial ball rendering bug introduced for rendering speed.

New features and improvements.text: Add optional joint-parallel-strength property for the ubiquitous-joint model.
Add optional length-calibration property to reduce grid-dependence for SUBI and strain-softening models.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix bug in structure hybrid import from-geometry.
Fix FoS legend value output.
Fix possible crash during removing geometry items while objects are partially destroyed.
Fix COMBA model when using table-like joint-friction/dilation property.
Fix bug in specifying server for network licenses.
Fix uninitialized variable that might be causing the intermittent save/restore problems.
Update of COMBA model. Remove default brittle on tension in matrix. Fix an issue for very a very high tension when flag-matrix-plastic is on.
Fix backwards compatibility of the default effective-cutoff value for model configure fluid.
Fix range logic for intersecting zone joints by commenting out this associated function.
Fix type in pyramid zone causing pressures applied to face 2 to result in possible floating point exception.

New features and improvements.text: Numerical improvement for the COMBA model.
Speed up cutting when join-by-contact is on.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix problems with the file decompressor on network shares.
Fix RapidTools manual input value glitch for input sliders.
Fix splash typo.
Fix legend not showing FoS value in FoS plot.

New features and improvements.text: The Jones-Wilkin-Lee (JWL) constitutive model has been added for representing explosives.
A bench blast design rapid tool has been added that combines empirical models for blast fragmentation and vibration.
An explosive rock interaction rapid tool has been added that gives the explosive energy distribution for different explosive types and rock types.
Several new blasting related examples are included including detailed models of single holes detonating, mine scale vibrations, fragmentation, and blasting throw and muckpile formation.
The Hoek Brown rapid tool has been enhanced to also provide a Mohr-Coulomb fit, fit uploaded data, and allow direct manipulation of the Hoek-Brown parameters.
Update of rapidtools-HB.
Add FISH function block.gp.accel.
MASSFLOW add FISH function of installmarkers.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix error of invalid vector subscript when operating cut-plane in model pane.
Fix issues in the license location dialog.

New features and improvements.text: Optimizations were perfomed on the comba model.
Added "Tension +ve" caption on structural cable contour plots.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix a bug in the second license system preventing the first license claim from making the second license available.
Fix the PROGRAM ENCRYPT command, encrypted data files can be read again.
Fix a bug copying a Hoek-Brown constitutive model.
Fix a bug applying stresses to triangular faces of zones that have two overlays (wedges, pyramids).
Fix a shutdown crash if you had just deleted all zones in the model.

New features and improvements.text: Add ability to turn off cleaning of rblock-rblock contacts before/after cycling.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix crash of shutting down related to object tree.
Fix dialog filtering system.
Fix for a string contains a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) at the beginning.
Fix reappering file after it's been removed from the project and subsequently deleted from the file system. This also fixes a crash from certain delete file operations.
Fix gridpoint merge issue when a merge happens across intersected zone joint in a non-circular order.
Fix when a gridpoint on a zone joint be both leader and follower.
Fix surface position when a cut plane and facets rendered.

New features and improvements.text: Object tree now works for user defined constitutive models

Bug Fixes.text: Fix bug causing plot to jump

New features and improvements.text: Set object tree updating during cycling to be off by default
Significant speedup to object tree updating
Multithreaded plotting of RBlocks

Bug Fixes.text: Fix bug in plotting axes of log charts
Fix bug that caused program crash if Warning dialog was clicked more than once
Fix bug that caused crash if cutting plane attributes were viewed before cutting plane was created
Fixed bug in plot commands for zone joints

Fix a problem with shortcuts on install if you had a previous version installed. Note the old version may have to be uninstalled manually.
Fix compatibilty with windows dark mode.
Fix an issue with floating point comparison sensitivity in various constitutive models.
The example dialog should default to examples featuring launching code on starup.
The example dialog "Current Program" option on open should now work again.
Fixed an issue with attach conditions when ZONE RELAX nulled zones they were attached to.
FLAC/PFC Fixed a bug assigning contact properties (zone joint properties in FLAC3D) using local FISH variables.
The history location plot item was not updating when colors were turned on and off.
Plot items should now update automatically when faces are triangulated.

New features and improvements.text: Object tree.
New constitutive model - CASM.
Moment thrust diagram for 3D structures.
Plot-item for gridpoints.
Updated Hoek-Brown interactive tool.
Add many new examples.
Add links of YouTube videos in documentation.
Many updates of documentation.
Improvement on cut-plane. Individual plotitem can select a sync cut-plane from the drop-down list.
Sketch can import edges from txt or csv file.
Add geometry command to create geometry edges from txt or csv file.
Add hide null gridpoint option.
Put zone joints to the results dialog.
Add bonded-particle modeling document.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix issue on Python user interface.
Fix bug on clock output for more than one hour cycling.
Fix Sketch issues related to the open pit wizard.
Fix Sketch some issues with moving notices.

Fix clump results when clumping balls and/or rblocks.
Fix a general bug in results for balls, clumps, rblocks.

New features and improvements.text: Allow the object tree to be clipped to a smaller size.
Modify FISH zone.prop.index so that it returns -1 for a unknown property name.
Add zone extras, properties and effective stress to zone export-data/import-data.
Allow for more than one face group.
Make contact model properties units consistent.
Only show cmat entry on the tree if there are or have been contacts.
Add Hill model for rblock-rblock contacts.
Fix export to wedge.

Fix grid file import commands filename parse not being tagged as for reading.
Sketch: fixed issue with incorrect DFN command issued by UI.
Sketch: fixed issue with polygons not being able to be selected for Joint-set, DFN, Voronoi when they are offset from 0 coordinate and 0 coordinate is not visible.
Fix bug in axisymmetry. Now Xmin is taken as the minimum value among all zones connected to the axis of symmetry.
Fix crash bug when using the contact range element in the cmat.

New features and improvements.text: CablePull update.
For new plots automatically change the tools panel to the plot item stack.
Enable MPI creep and fix a bug related to MPI average mechanical ratio.
Extruder page accepts drops.
Sketch: add an option to combine DFN.

Remove alias of model property causing property plotting issue.

Fix for 2D structural elements.

Cable Pull Rapid Tool: Added point for displacement plot. Displacement plot ends at x-axis maximum.
Sketch: Updated behavior of preview button and random controls for joint-set, DFN, and Voronoi dialogs.

Fix modification list URL.
Fix tolerance error in geometry range elements.

Cable Pull Rapid Tool: Update commands to reflect corrent displacement value from slider.

Fix to flow plane generation.

New features and improvements.text: Added the CablePull rapid tool.
The asterix * prefix to suppress warnings from a command can now be used at the end of a command line as well. All examples in the manual use this option.
Improve performance of Maxwell Damping when nodal-mixed-discretization is active.
Improve slot filtering logic when a large number of lots are present in Sketch.
Sketch: introduced new option 'min-size' to specify minimum number of zones per edge when setting edge length or using auto-zoning.
Updated zone/face separation by-slot. Added new keyword distinct-geometry to distinguish if faces came from edges in Sketch.
Added DFN example.
New fill air markes with solid materials.
Added new FISH functions.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix bug in the Swell constitutive model.
Fix a nunmber of places where the floating point status flag was being set in normal operations. Work is still ongoing here.
Fix a possible crash when using Maxwell Damping on structural elements with no links.
Fix a bug in structural element vector plotting in 2D.
Fix a problem when a gridpoint attached to a face belongs to a null zone.
Fix bug when nulling zones around zone joints.
Fix apply face conditions in MPI.
Fix nodal-mixed-discretizatino support in MPI.
Fix contouring of non-existent extra variables.
Fix missing figures in documentation.
Fix installer leaving behind old shortcuts.
Fix bug in recent projects list.
Updated check for modifications URL.
Added error message when axisymmetry is enabled with dynamic, fluid, or thermal processes active.

New features and improvements.text: General updates and improvements to installation configuration and naming.

Bug Fixes.text: Prevent rare crash in attach logic.
Another fix to vector plots using the boundary option.
Fix a memory leak in MPI.
Fix another constitutive model compatibility break introduced in Revision 17.
Fix error in the geometry translate command that made it take a long time.
Fix bug in DFN intersection plot item.
Fix crash if you assign properties before a constitutive model in the model pane.
Fixes for the project tree and to plot items modified on the command line.

New features and improvements.text: The folder names used on installation should no longer use the minor version number, and should be tagged as being associated with the Perpetual or Subscription version.
Added zone gridpoint pore-pressure table command.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix plastic strain calculation issue with the strain softening model.
Fix crash on close that affected FLAC and 3DEC.
Fix possible user interface crash.
The correct help page is loaded on startup.
Fix bug in structural element rigid connection to zones in dynamic calculations -- the gravitational mass contributions could be lost.
Allow the deformation factor attribute field to fit arbitrarily large values.

New features and improvements.text: Point-release version 9.20.
Icons updated for Stop and Update notifications.
Add Python packages numpy-stl, stl-reader, and networkx.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix possible crash removing free field boundary.
Fix FISH callback interval status after save/restore.

New features and improvements.text: The AI assistant now has a link on the main help menu.
MPI support for dynamic free-field boundary conditions, and dynamic multi-stepping.
CMAKE contact model creation works differently in Windows and Linux. The directions have been updated.
Add swell slope example.
Added command block fluid tension and FISH function block.fluid.tension.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix Linux console version not finding the main engine on launch.
Fix ghost tool buttons showing up in project pane.
Fix example dialog failing to find examples text file.
Fix settings menu button missing from compressed plot toolbar.
Fix to zone join force-displacement law when the joint starts inactive.
Fix to specific discharge plots crashing after importing results files with pore pressures.
Add zone joint example with backfill.
Sketch: Fixed issue when generating the joint set in the UI within a block with multiple internal closed polygons.
Sketch: Fixed issues with edges on extruder scene with are hidden when switching between views.
Fix bug in FOS analysis with excavated blocks.

New features and improvements.text: First version of 9.20 available.
Added the Curved Mohr-Coulomb model - allowing for a generalized failure surface.
Added FISH intrinsic struct.cable.tension.state, struct.cable.tension.value, struct.pile.tension.state, and struct.pile.tension.value.
Joint set support in Sketch tool.
Bar plot options for structural elements.
Moment-thrust plot for structural elements.
Added braced excavation example.
Saving, Restoring, and clearing a model state should be 1.5 to 3x faster.
Added support for three levels of cluster capability as options.
Removed option requirement for user-defined constitutive model use.
Added drawdown verification problem.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix possible crash when adjusting line width in remote desktop.
Fix issue of missing signals when re-showing a new page in sets by not hiding the outgoing page, and now the workspace hide/show button will ensure content is properly displayed.
Fix issue when finding nearest gridpoint and zone and picking problems with geometry plotting.
Remove alias of property name in Plastic-Hardening model which causing issue in property contour plot.

New features and improvements.text: You can now delete a plot from the workspace view.
Water table plot improvements - now the water table is on the center of the grid.
Added FISH library functions struct.cable.tension.state, struct.cable.tension.value, struct.pile.tension.state, and struct.pile.tension.value.

Bug Fixes.text: Fix bug of broken interactive targets in revision 170 which affects plot query.
Fix acceleration recorded on structural nodes with a rigid link.
Plot pull-down menu buttons make the associated plot the current plot.
Fix picking (object identification under the mouse) for the geometry plot item.
Fix zone joint issue on zones being nulled and backfilled.
The various find.near FISH intrinsics could have poor performance on models with highly variable zone distribution. They should perform more consistently now.
Fix model solve-dynamic command - a bug with the time limit.
Fix a crash that could occur when deleting zone joints.
Changes to mechanical stress stored when using zone face apply pore-pressure are now discarded if a zone fluid steady-state command is given.
Fix to stress initialization when pore-pressures are present.

Bug fixes.text: Fix for 9.0 constitutive models not loading into 9.1. NOTE Constitutive models created using 9.1 will have to be re-compiled.
Fixed crash that could occur on code shutdown.
Fixed a couple of crashes associated with a compiler update in the Linux version.
Fixed the case-insensitive find method.
Minor adjustments to tolerances in the steady-state fluid solver.
Fixed a bug in the steady-state solver if fluid model invalid zones and the linear-first option were both present.

New features and improvements.text: Add ability to turn off pore-pressure updates for contact models in zone joints.
Change the minimum allowed fluid permeability factor back down to 1e-6.
Remove 15% Maxwell damping limit.
Upgrade the pillow Python package.

Bug fixes.text: Fix memory leak in FISH extra variables.
Fix second license incompatibility between v700 and v900 and up.
Fix inline help move bug in Windows.
Fix startup dialog bug if an empty path was on the recent projects list.
Prevent crash to desktop if internal data structures have become corrupted.
Disable Strength-Stress-Ratio calculations if the constitutive model does not support it.
Improve plots of dynamic timestep if attach conditions were present.
FALC Fix zone gridpoint merge bug if three or more gridpoints needed to be merged.
Contact model mohr remains active if the pore-pressures is non-zero

New features and improvements.text: zone face apply pore-pressure-maximum should now work as expected for all unsaturated flow models.
The direct solver will now automatically drop into indefinite mode on failure and try again. This greatly reduces the likelihood of convergence failure in the zone fluid steady-state command.

Bug fixes.text: Restoring a 2D model file into a 3D instance (and vice versa) will now produce an error rather than a shutdown.
Tolerancing issues corrected in implicit support for unsaturated flow using the cutoff model.

Results of the zone fluid steady-state command were not deterministic. This has been corrected but at the cost of the command taking longer to execute. Work will be done in the future to speed this up again, and to address similar issues that likely exist in the implicit transient solver as well.

New features and improvements.text: Locally changed data files will no longer be saved automatically if you reset project.
Update zone plot label numeric values so they will be shorter and use the current global precision setting.

Added a linear-first keyword to the zone fluid steady-state command. This does a linear solution first to get close to the final phreatic surface so subsequent iterations have less changes to make to saturation.
Added a minimum-relax keyword to the zone fluid steady-state command. This allows customization of the lowest relax factor allowed during iterations. The new default value is 0.5.

Bug fixes.text: Fixed bug in zone fluid steady-state command if a region of zones was inactive in fluid.
Fixed bug in zone fluid steady-state command that could cause gridpoints with a fixed pore-pressure to change.
Fixed thermal and fluid response if only the follower of an attach condition was fixed.
Fixed sketch tool object properties not being displayed if the tool was the first use of attributes in the user interface.

New features and improvements.text: Updated example dialog documentation.
Added Python support for structural pile, beam, cable, shell, liner, geogrid, and node arrays.
Set the Comba constitutive model property flag-matrix-plastic to true by default.
Removed horizontal lines between attribute widgets in plot attributes.
Added ability to resize the caption (name) area in the attribute widgets panel.
Extra variables now stored in a more memory efficient manner if non-sequential indices are used.
Added verification problem Unconfined Flow Riverbank from FLAC classic.
The zone gridpoint pore-pressure import command now works in 2D.
Added pcg-limit and latency keyword options for zone fluid implicit servo and zone thermal implicit servo.

Added zone effective-stress-cutoff keyword - used as the cutoff to pore-pressure for the purpose of calculating effective stress. Note that this change violates backward compatibility if negative pore-pressures were present and model configure fluid-flow was not done.
Update zone label plots to shorten numeric values and use the current precision model state setting.

Bug fixes.text: Fixed plot images missing from example documentation.
Fixed a bug that could cause the UI to attempt to open a given plot multiple times.
Fixed a possible crash rendering lines in OpenGL.
Fixed a problem setting the bitmap size in the plot export to bitmap dialog.
Fixed a fluid solve limit bug in model solve-fluid-decoupled.
Fix possible crash trying to export a geometry set.
Fixed nearest Gp indication in plot information (as well as other possible interaction selection) when a job or model title was present in the plot.
Fixed a possible application hang while rendering some objects in a plot.
Changes to data files will no longer automatically be saved if the project is reset.
Fixed a bug in the zone fluid steady-state solver if many zones were set to inactive.

Major improvements.text: Reliabilty of fluid implicit nonlinear iterative convergence significantly increased.
Improvements to fluid and thermal implicit timestep servo behavior.

New features and improvements.text: User Interface: Tools area opens automatically if F1 is pressed to request context help.
User Interface: Thinned main splitters, reduced height of title bars.
User Interface: Errors resulting from executing selected lines in the editor will now correctly report file and line number.
Added built-in Python packages scikit-learn, pyDOE, stl, and seaborn.
Documentation: Added page for new example dialog.
Added tunnel flow example.
Prototype support for zone gridpoint pore-pressure import in 2D.
Added support for Python structural beam arrays.
Fluid Flow: Changed default implicit servo error check interval to 40 steps.
Fluid Flow: Changed default implicit servo error limit upwards.
The zone gridpoint pore-pressure commands now defaults to no cutoff. If the cutoff keyword is given without a value zero is assumed.
The zone fluid steady-state command now defaults to no cutoff. If the cutoff keyword is given without a value zero is assumed.
deviation-lognormal option added to the zone property-distribution command.
Added zone fluid timestep maximum and zone fluid timestep fix commands.
Added zone thermal timestep maximum and zone thermal timestep fix commands.
Added total keyword to the block insitu topography command.

Bug fixes.text: User Interface: A Workspace tile could occasionally dissapear when you try to replace it's contents.
User Interface: The Linux version had a crash issue when clicking in help displayed in Tools.
Fluid Flow: Fixed a bug in the implicit servo causing the timestep to increase again too fast.
Fluid Flow: Fixed a number of issues causing nonlinear implicit convergence instability.
Thermal: Moved a number of implicit servo fixes from fluid to thermal, improving performance.
Fix parsing error in the zone gridpoint pore-pressure initialize command.

New features and improvements.text: Minor UI adjustments for ease of use on 4k monitors.
All built-in constitutive models are now considered standard, none are advanced.
Added the ability to cap a gaussian distribution of properties when using the deviation-gaussian keyword.
Further optimization to fluid/thermal coupled solving.

Bug fixes.text: Fixed a problem with the Search tool in the examples dialog box.
Fixes a restore issue if you had loaded user defined models when saving that did not exist when restoring.
Added missing Hoek-Brown calculator files.
MASSFLOW Remove three properties from the visualization option
MASSFLOW Updated mass requested and actual.
MASSFLOW Fixed DrawRate to start at day 0
MASSFLOW Further work on marker properties.
MASSFLOW Updates due to DrawRequest fixed.

New features and improvements.text: Added options to the IPython console tool bar.
The Workspace content selector now shows a check for the current save state.
Prevent a few rare cases crashing the user interface.
Added "Plot Items" fly out menu to the plot context menu allowing setting of attributes of any plot item even if currently inactive.
The "Add plot item" plot context menu action is now always available.
Added support for tensors types to the documentation system.
Added nearest Gp to the Information box in the Model area of the Workspace.
Added cutoff keywords to the relevant zone gridpoint pore-pressure options.
The datum keyword in zone gridpoint pore-pressure has changed to work against a general gravity vector.
Maxwell damping has been improved for nonlinear constitutive models in zones, structural elements, and structural links.
Allow plotting of link values on multiple sides for 1-D structural elements.
Plots of pore-pressure Head and the gp.head FISH intrinsic now work even if model config fluid-flow has not been given.
Changed the keyword water-density to fluid-density for consistency in all examples.
Added example of using zone joints with attach conditions.
Added filename keyword options to zone gridpoint pore-pressure geometry.
Sped up fluid property plotting on large models.
Added cutoff keyword support to head and pore-pressure apply conditions.
Added a zone fluid density command as a synonym for zone fluid-density.
Added pore-pressure-maximum applied boundary condition in support of fully saturated flow calculations. This is sometimes called an unknown boundary condition.
Removed restriction on fluid implicit timestep.
MASSFLOW New FISH functions added.

Bug fixes.text: Fix a few Windows version specific issues with the new Examples dialog.
Fix geometry import bug in DXF polylines.
Pore-pressure and head applied boundary conditions will no longer apply values greater than the fluid tension if the cutoff model is on the grid-point.
Many bug fixes and performance optimizations to transient implicit unsaturated flow calculations.

MASSFLOW Algorithmic speed-up: Restructure of internal DrawRequest module. Importing the Draw Period file (.csv) now takes almost no time. We moved from 10 hours in v9.0 for a large mine to less than 2 seconds in v9.1.

New features and improvements.text: Added Copy button to the warnings dialog
Changed the zone fluid scale-modulus command to zone fluid modulus-scale
Added zone fluid modulus-automatic command.
Added 3D version of a brazilian test example.
Add ability to specify variable viscoscity for joint flow.

MASSFLOW Over 10 new fish functions. Users can interrogate and dynamically adapt the block model properties and markers properties, providing more flexibility for cave analysis, such as static days in caved blocks, and lower and upper fragmentation limits on rock fragmentation (markers).
MASSFLOW Caved properties in block model. In this new version, users can now keep track of grades and rock properties, at block support, as the cave process progresses.

Bug fixes.text: Optimized and repaired face group tracking for large models.
Fixed URL link in license dialog.
Fixed legend on shell resultant plots.
An HL network key will now be seen connected directly with localhost as the network location name.
Fix a bug in the zone separate command if the old gridpoint was not connected to any non-null zone.
Fix parsing error in zone geometry command.
Prevent apply conditions from applying a pore-pressure below the tension when using the cutoff unsaturated flow model.
Corrected error in how fluid volume increments from mechanical volume changes were applied.
Correct implicit flow bug when using two way mechanical coupling.
Fix possible crash bug in zone joints when nulling adjacent zones.
Fixed two issues preventing the steady state flow solver from converging in unsaturated conditions.
Sketch: Mesh gridlines were not shown in certain circumstances.
Sketch: Automatic rotation of background geometry was not working.

Fix the struct.force.nodal FISH intrinsic.
